claims.claim: Slightly used PS4 game CDs / brand new CDs are available.
claims.evidence: The witness only saw boxed retail packages with labels/barcodes (including “GHOSTWIRE” and “FIFA 22”) and PS5/4PS markings; it does not confirm whether discs are PS4 vs PS5, whether they are used vs brand new, or whether CDs/discs are included.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired.
claims.evidence: No shot shows whether the discs are sealed/opened or whether any repair/opening occurred; only outer boxes/labels were visible.
The report describes game boxes/cases, not a console; there is no evidence of overheating or ports.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No evidence of “original pads” or a UK receipt in the witness observations.

risks.risk: Discs may be missing or not included (only boxes/cases were shown).
risks.proof: A clear video/clip showing each game opened (or the disc visible in the case) with the disc label matching the box title, plus a close-up of the disc surface (scratches).
risks.if_unproven: Price as boxed games with unknown disc inclusion/condition (worst case: discs missing or untested).

risks.risk: Region/compatibility mismatch (PS4 vs PS5 versions; region lock).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the back/side of each case showing platform (PS4/PS5) and region/format details, plus a photo of the disc label indicating PS4/PS5.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially incompatible/region-locked titles (worst case: cannot be played on the buyer’s console).

risks.risk: Working condition unknown (may not install or may have damaged discs).
risks.proof: A short clip of one disc being inserted and the game launching/installation starting on a PS4/PS5 (whichever matches the disc), showing no error.

risks.risk: Incomplete packaging (missing manuals/inserts) or damaged cases.
risks.proof: Photos of the full contents laid out per game (case + disc + inserts/manuals) and close-ups of case condition (cracks, broken hinges).
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/possibly damaged retail packaging (worst case: missing inserts).

risks.risk: Quantity and exact titles are unclear (some labels not fully readable).
risks.proof: A single overhead shot listing all titles clearly, or a count with readable close-ups of each box front/back.
risks.if_unproven: Price for the worst-case assumption: fewer/less valuable titles than claimed.

risks.risk: Packaging authenticity/condition (original vs replacement packaging; storage damage like warping).
risks.proof: Close-up of seals/printing quality and a photo showing any storage damage (warping, moisture marks) on the cases.
risks.if_unproven: Price as standard used retail packaging with unknown storage history (worst case: moisture/warping).

proof_requests: For each game: clear photo of the disc inside the case with the disc label matching the box title.
Close-up of the case back showing PS4 vs PS5 compatibility and any region/format markings.
A short video showing one disc being inserted and the game launching/installation starting without errors.
Photos showing whether manuals/inserts are present (open the case and show contents).
A readable inventory shot/count of all titles included (front and back of each box).
Photos of any receipts/UK proof if available.
response.reason: The witness confirms only boxed retail packages with some visible titles/markings, but cannot verify disc inclusion, PS4 vs PS5 compatibility, region, or working condition—so a reliable worst-case price cannot be set without missing shots.
